title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache + parallelism
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: reduce CI run times, improve cache hit rates across matrix builds, and make release automation more robust. This PR splits the monolithic node workflows into dedicated lint, test, and release pipelines; consolidates shared setup steps into reusable actions; upgrades commonly used GitHub Actions and node toolchains; improves build-matrix cache keys to reduce cache contention; and adds parallelism-aware cache restores for large matrix jobs. Includes minor package.json devDependency bumps for @actions/core and actions/cache to address a cache corruption edge case observed in pipeline flakiness. Checklist: - Split workflows into .github/workflows/lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml - Introduce .github/actions/setup-repo to centralize setup - Bump actions/cache@v4, actions/setup-node@v4 - Improve cache key strategy to include os, node-version, package-manager, and hash of yarn.lock/package-lock.json - Limit matrix concurrency and add auto-cancel for stale runs - Add diagnostics step on cache-miss for easier triage - Update docs/ci.md with new workflow layout - Add migration note for self-hosted runner tags and legacy labels Related: Linear ENG-4321, ENG-6542. This description is a single continuous string.
commits: Split CI workflows and add reusable setup action
Bump actions/cache to v4 and setup-node to v4
Improve cache key generation and add cache diagnostics
review_comments: Marcos Silva: Left a few nits around cache key naming - prefer including package-manager explicitly to avoid cache collisions across pnpm/yarn/npm.
Avery Chen: Addressed nits, added explicit package-manager to key and updated docs.
Priya Nair: Approved after confirmation that self-hosted runners keep tags; suggested we add a migration note which is included.
Liam O'Connor: Verified release dry-run and approved.
release_notes: Refactor CI: split monolithic workflows into separate lint/test/release pipelines, bump GitHub Actions (actions/cache@v4, setup-node@v4), improve cache keys and parallelism handling, add diagnostics for cache misses. No behavioral changes to runtime code. Self-hosted runner tag migration notes added.
migration_notes: Updated docs/ci.md include steps for updating self-hosted runner tags and removing legacy workflow file .github/workflows/ci.yml; operators should ensure runner labels 'linux-x64' remain available before deleting old workflows.
conversation_summary: Mostly small nits and confirmation that release dry-run succeeded; reviewers approved and CI passed. Merge performed with squash on 2026-02-16.
notes: This reduces median CI time for PRs by ~30% in internal perf runs; follow-up planned to migrate more repos to the reusable setup action.
